answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x target and isolated to the primary region during peak settlement writes. Rollback is disallowed by the security-patch constraint. Circuit breaking would shed customer writes and violates the objective. Read-replica routing previously helped by offloading report/read traffic, which does not match a writes-heavy settlement peak. Capacity headroom historically worked when added before a peak, not mid-surge. Regional failover is the closest prior (latency recovered in minutes, traffic shifted cleanly) and matches the region-scoped symptom while keeping writes flowing. Verifying b2 and b3 before treating that analogy as settled. Residual uncertainty: secondary-region health, whether the new build is present there, and settlement-path blast radius of a live write failover.
